-- =================================================================
-- Description:	This gets a basic report for [Ubicacion] table
-- =================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rpt_Ubicacion_Index]
@EntityId AS INT = 0, 
@Comunidad_Id AS INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	
	-- IMPORTANT:
	-- This is a computer generated procedure.  DO NOT ADD CUSTOM CODE TO THIS PROCEDURE.

	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	-- 1) CREATE FILTER TABLE:
	DECLARE @UbicacionFilter TABLE (
		Id INT IDENTITY (1,1),
		Ubicacion_Id INT		
	)


    -- IF A GIVEN ID HAS BEEN SPECIFIED, THEN RETRIEVE THAT RECORD ONLY
	IF @EntityId <> 0
	BEGIN

		INSERT INTO @UbicacionFilter (Ubicacion_Id)
		SELECT 
			[Ubicacion].Id
		FROM [dbo].[Ubicacion]
		WHERE
			 [dbo].[Ubicacion].[Id] = @EntityId

	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN

		-- 2) FILTER BY FOREIGN RELATIONSHIPS WHEN APLICABLE:
		INSERT INTO @UbicacionFilter (Ubicacion_Id)
		SELECT 
			[Ubicacion].Id
		FROM [dbo].[Ubicacion]
		WHERE
			 (([Ubicacion].[Comunidad_Id] = @Comunidad_Id) OR (@Comunidad_Id = 0))

 	END

 
	-- 4) DELIVER THE FILTERED RESULTS:
	SELECT 
		[Ubicacion].[Id],
		[Ubicacion].[Nombre],
		[Ubicacion].[Comunidad_Id],
		[Comunidad].[Nombre] AS [ComunidadNombre]
	FROM @UbicacionFilter filter
		JOIN [dbo].[Ubicacion] 
			ON [Ubicacion].[Id] = filter.[Ubicacion_Id] 
			

		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Comunidad]
		ON [dbo].[Ubicacion].[Comunidad_Id] = [dbo].[Comunidad].[Id] 

 
END
-- END OF [dbo].[cgp_Ubicacion_Index]
Name: rpt_Ubicacion_Index
